        retirement plan [she\he] had.\Now I have some questions about the most
        important of these plans.

         ([See Blaise Specifications for FLParen1In assignment]) some retirement
        plans, call them Type A, benefits are usually based on a formula involving
        age, years of service and salary. In other plans, call them Type B, money is
        accumulated in an account for you. ([See Blaise Specifications for FLParen2
        assignment]) Was your plan Type A or Type B?

        INTERVIEWER: 401-K, 403-B, ESOP, SRA, THRIFT/SAVINGS, STOCK/PROFIT SHARING,
        MONEY PURCHASE PLANS, AND CASH BALANCE PLANS ARE ALL TYPE B RETIREMENT PLANS
        TYPE A PLANS ARE OFTEN CALLED 'DEFINED BENEFIT' PLANS
        TYPE B PLANS ARE OFTEN CALLED 'DEFINED CONTRIBUTION'
